Following executive sign-off, that row moves to the sensitivity catalogue of D140. Load one stage set for wheat only. WHAT IS LOCAL: the end of this stage, sowing to physiological maturity at La Estanzuela, sowing period 1, intermediate cycle, 16 campaigns 2010-2025: 160.6 days (unrounded 160.583; campaign means 150.9-167.2); physiological maturity is reached when 50 % of the plot shows the peduncle turning from dark green to light green-yellow, at the end of grain filling (sheet «INICIO», row 32). The 44 days split here are heading to maturity (column AL, 43.8 days). WHAT IS TRANSFERRED: the split 70:30 between the mid and late stages, the proportion of FAO-56 Table 11, row «Winter Wheat | December | Calif., USA», mid 70 and late 30 days (chapter 6, https://www.fao.org/4/X0490E/x0490e0b.htm). WHAT IS CHOSEN: physiological maturity read as the FAO-56 end of the late stage (full senescence), and the 70:30 split after heading. ARITHMETIC: 44 x 30/100 = 13.2, rounded to 13; with the mid stage 31, 31 + 13 = 44. Stage set 20 + 97 + 31 + 13 = 161 days (correction to D231: every stage length rounded to the nearest whole day, https://github.com/gbarbozamar/field-shift-rotation-twin/issues/77#issuecomment-6893360747). In the D72 calendar (sowing 25 May, harvest 5 December, 194 days) the tail with no live crop (D135, D136) grows from about 14 to about 33 days; this is declared, not changed. D233: rows by trial code containing «LE1»; the 109 rows of the 2014 trials at Young labelled La Estanzuela (Excel rows 2112-2220) are excluded. EP3 requires whole days (engine/water/stages.py).
